lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.21 - A Listen and number

details: Listen and number checks students' recall of the target vocabulary from Units 5 and 6 (appearance and clothes) and gives them the opportunity to practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the target vocabulary and correct numbering of the boxes.
“We need to use our best describing skills today! How would you describe each of these pictures?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.21 - B. Listen and choose

details: Listen and choose reviews the target language and key structures from Units 5 and 6 and offers a further opportunity to practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the pictures based on the descriptions and correct circling of the letters.
“Time for a test of your describing skills! Which picture is being described?”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.75 - A Read and match

details: Read and match checks students' understanding of the key language at a sentence level and strengthens recognition of target words with word-picture matching reinforcing whole-word memory.
Look for students correctly identifying the images and  drawing lines to the correct sentences.
“Uh oh, the sentences and the pictures are in the wrong order! Can you use your skills to help me match the sentences to the correct pictures?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.75 - B Look and write

details: Look and write strengthens recognition of the target language and key structures and gives students an opportunity to practise them by writing the appropriate question or answer on the lines, reinforcing language chunk recall.
Look for correct word choice, word order and spelling, neat handwriting on the lines and appropriate spacing between the words.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - C. Listen and read

details: Listen and read allows students to review the key structures and target language from Units 5 and 6, learn about traditional clothes in other cultures and practise their literacy skills.
Look for careful listening, students following the text while they listen, and clear pronunciation, steady pacing and correct identification of each word while they read.
“Wow, look at all of the cool clothes! Let’s find out who wears them!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

Heads Together:

Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - D. Choose or write the correct answers 10m]

details: Choose the correct answers checks students’ understanding of the text and gives them an opportunity to practise reading for understanding.
Look for correct circling/writing of the answers and the ability to identify where in the text they found the answers.
“How would you describe these clothes? Let’s answer these questions to help us find the right words.”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Chant): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video Chant): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4R

Diary:
Revisit the diary page so Ss can add new words or phrases, revisit their learning goal and complete tracking for that lesson.
